Consent form auto-attached to the project. Deposit pool created — $600, $420 banked at booking. - <>Session 1 (Day 0): The first three hours. Photos: REF and FRESH. The artist's notes go in: "Reacted well to red, slight wincing on outline" — those notes will surface on session 2 automatically. - <>Day 7: HEAL photo uploads from the client kiosk. Session 2 booked for Day 14. Pool re-applied: $120 of the $420 for S2. - <>Day 70: HEALED photo uploads. Project closes. The full record — bookings, deposits, consents, photos, notes — archives to her client record. Portfolio auto-updates. - quote: "I used to keep four spreadsheets per client. Not a slot." - italicWord "Not a slot" - subhead about 14-day trial ## Implementation Imports needed: Lucide LayoutGrid, DollarSign, ImageIcon, Calendar, FileText, AlertCircle, MessageSquare, Sparkles, Users, CreditCard. ## Verification After both files: `cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/InkOS" && pnpm run type-check`.
